title: Builder Dead Capability API Removal
problem: SiumaiBuilder exposes capability string helpers that are write-only and do not influence registry-owned provider construction.
objective: Remove the no-op builder capability field and helper methods, then guard against reintroducing capability strings as a false builder control plane.
gates: cargo nextest run -p siumai-registry --test builder_architecture_boundary_test builder_does_not_expose_noop_capability_flags --no-default-features --features openai --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: Lane closed after removing only SiumaiBuilder's no-op capability storage and helpers. ProviderCapabilities fluent methods remain provider metadata and are intentionally untouched.
